abstract: The patient was a 9-month-old girl who presented with an abdominal mass. Computed tomography scan revealed that the huge heterogeneous mass with cystic, calcified, and solid components occupied the upper abdomen, and diagnosis of teratoma was made preoperatively. At the operation, a tumor arising from gallbladder and gliomatosis peritonei with intact ovaries were found. This is a rare case report of teratoma that originated in the gallbladder associated with gliomatosis peritonei.
abstract_ja: 患者は9か月の女児で、腹部腫瘤を主訴に受診した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)検査では、嚢胞性、石灰化、充実性の成分を含む巨大で不均一な腫瘤が上腹部を占めており、術前に奇形腫と診断された。手術では、胆嚢から発生した腫瘍と腹膜神経膠腫症が認められ、両側卵巣は正常であった。胆嚢から発生し腹膜神経膠腫症を伴った奇形腫の、稀な症例報告である。
